Messages.Body:
I'd just like to find out if I've kept up with all the different Promos
that has come out for jyhad/vtes.

1) Dan Murdock. Caitiff
Could get him coupon in back of the book, "On a Darkling Plain"

2) Mariana Gilbert. Toreador.
Could get her by going to a specific type of traveling Con.

(you could get both by writing to them, also)

So, are there any more that i missed??
thanks,
dustin

Messages.Body:

You can send a SASE to WotC and get them both for $0.64 (two
stamps: one there, one back) as far as I know. At least, you
used to be able to. At first you could even do it with just an
e-mail, saving the postage, but I think they did away with that
practice so they saved on postage.

-Dave Green
